title: Premise-based Multimodal Reasoning: Conditional Inference on Joint Textual and Visual Clues

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates "textual bias" (spurious correlations) introduced by crowd-sourcing. This is measured by training text-only "blind" baselines (BERT) to determine if the multimodal task can be solved using only language priors, and by calculating Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) between specific words and answer labels to identify words that are spuriously correlated with the ground truth.
